title: expand_url_template single-pass scan is correct at all boundaries
description: The single-pass pointer-chasing approach (rest = &rest[open+1..] and rest = &rest[close+1..]) correctly handles templates with multiple variables, adjacent variables, and no-variable suffixes without regex or a second pass. The error-on-unknown-variable design is correct: silently leaving {name} in the URL would produce a broken request with a misleading error at the HTTP layer, not at the call site. A future contributor might suggest using a regex crate or silently passing through unknown variables; both are wrong. The current approach is deliberately minimal and correct.
